transforms.name: vite:load-fallback
transforms.result:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{
  R: number
  C: number
  V0: number
  currentV: number
  tau: number
  simTime: number
  mode: 'charge' | 'discharge'
  phase: 'ready' | 'running' | 'done'
  running: boolean
  paused: boolean
}>()

const canvasRef = ref<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null)
let animId = 0
let lastTs = 0
let dpr = 1
let cw = 600
let ch = 400

const emit = defineEmits<{ (e: 'updateSim', dt: number): void }>()

function getCtx() { const c = canvasRef.value; return c ? c.getContext('2d') : null }
function resizeCanvas() {
  const c = canvasRef.value
  if (!c) return
  const rect = c.getBoundingClientRect()
  dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1
  cw = Math.round(rect.width)
  ch = Math.round(rect.height)
  c.width = Math.round(cw * dpr)
  c.height = Math.round(ch * dpr)
}

function draw() {
  const ctx = getCtx()
  if (!ctx) return
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0)
  const w = cw, h = ch
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0B1220'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)

  const scale = Math.min(w / 560, h / 360)
  const s = (v: number) => v * scale
  const cx = w / 2
  const cy = h / 2

  // Battery
  const batW = s(30), batH = s(15)
  const batX = cx - s(150), batY = cy - batH / 2
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2A3540'; ctx.fillRect(batX, batY, batW, batH)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4A6572'; ctx.lineWidth = s(2); ctx.strokeRect(batX, batY, batW, batH)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'; ctx.font = `bold ${s(7)}px sans-serif`; ctx.textAlign = 'center'
  ctx.fillText(`${props.V0}V`, batX + batW / 2, batY + batH / 2 + s(3))

  // Wire top
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4A6572'; ctx.lineWidth = s(2)
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(batX + batW, batY + batH / 2); ctx.lineTo(cx + s(80), batY + batH / 2); ctx.stroke()

  // Resistor
  const resX = cx - s(40), resY = batY + batH / 2
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#fbbf24'; ctx.lineWidth = s(2)
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(resX, resY)
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    ctx.lineTo(resX + s(5) + i * s(6), resY + (i % 2 === 0 ? -s(6) : s(6)))
  }
  ctx.lineTo(resX + s(40), resY)
  ctx.stroke()
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8B95A5'; ctx.font = `${s(7)}px sans-serif`
  ctx.fillText(`R=${props.R}Ω`, resX + s(20), resY - s(10))

  // Wire bottom
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4A6572'; ctx.lineWidth = s(2)
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(batX, batY + batH / 2); ctx.lineTo(cx - s(80), cy + s(60)); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + s(80), batY + batH / 2); ctx.lineTo(cx + s(80), cy + s(60)); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - s(80), cy + s(60)); ctx.lineTo(cx + s(80), cy + s(60)); ctx.stroke()

  // Capacitor
  const capX = cx + s(60), capY1 = cy - s(20), capY2 = cy + s(20)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#4A6572'; ctx.lineWidth = s(2)
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(capX, capY1); ctx.lineTo(capX + s(20), capY1); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(capX, capY2); ctx.lineTo(capX + s(20), capY2); ctx.stroke()
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5B8DB8'; ctx.font = `${s(7)}px sans-serif`
  ctx.fillText(`C=${(props.C * 1000).toFixed(0)}μF`, capX + s(25), cy + s(3))

  // Voltage bar
  const barW = s(100), barH = s(8)
  const barX = cx - s(50), barY = cy + s(80)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1A232E'; ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW, barH)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#2D3645'; ctx.strokeRect(barX, barY, barW, barH)
  const vRatio = props.V0 > 0 ? props.currentV / props.V0 : 0
  ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e'; ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, barW * vRatio, barH)

  // Labels
  ctx.fillStyle = '#8B95A5'; ctx.font = `${s(8)}px sans-serif`; ctx.textAlign = 'center'
  ctx.fillText(`V = ${props.currentV.toFixed(2)} V`, cx, barY + barH + s(12))
  ctx.fillText(`t = ${props.simTime.toFixed(2)} s`, cx, barY + barH + s(22))

  const labels: Record<string, { text: string; color: string }> = {
    ready: { text: '🔋 جاهز — اضغط Start', color: '#64748b' },
    running: { text: props.mode === 'charge' ? '⚡ جاري الشحن...' : '⚡ جاري التفريغ...', color: '#fbbf24' },
    done: { text: '✅ اكتمل', color: '#22c55e' },
  }
  const pl = labels[props.phase]
  ctx.fillStyle = pl.color; ctx.font = `bold ${s(12)}px sans-serif`
  ctx.fillText(pl.text, w / 2, s(18))
}

function loop(ts: number) {
  const dt = lastTs ? Math.min((ts - lastTs) / 1000, 0.05) : 0
  lastTs = ts
  emit('updateSim', dt)
  draw()
  animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop)
}

function onResize() { resizeCanvas(); draw() }
onMounted(() => { resizeCanvas(); draw(); animId = requestAnimationFrame(loop); window.addEventListener('resize', onResize) })
onUnmounted(() => { cancelAnimationFrame(animId); window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize) })
</script>
<template>
  <canvas ref="canvasRef" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block;" />
</template>
